description: This file defines a utility object 'JoinUtils' with a function to join elements of a linked list into a single string separated by spaces. It operates on a custom 'LinkedList' class and provides a helper method for string concatenation.

classes.name: JoinUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing a method to join list elements into a string.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates elements of a linked list into a single string with spaces separating each element.
